operations.title: The exact orbit-9 arrow closes the last gap only in the bounded 61-presentation continuation graph
operations.body: The orbit-9 row-Gram arrow is exact and removes the sole residual singleton from the bounded nonlinear census. The other connecting arrows remain numerical continuations unless separately exactified. Therefore current evidence gives one connected bounded carrier graph on 61 presentations, not yet a wholly exact groupoid presentation.

operations.title: Nima narrows the orbit-9 correction to the bounded continuation graph
operations.body: Typing correction: the orbit-9 row-Gram bridge is exact, but it only closes the last gap in the existing bounded nonlinear graph. It does not exactify the other numerical arrows. The correct next task is exactification of a minimal spanning set of those arrows, followed by loop coherence—not cocycle testing on a falsely assumed exact groupoid.
